mostWorthwhile.text: Following ADH to the kidney was most worthwhile: the added water channels made it clearer how the signal helps conserve water.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hormone route to the body felt a little repetitive after seeing how the signal reached the kidneys.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the picture to show fewer ADH signals as the blood concentration returned toward its usual range.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the nerve endings and blood vessels were shown together, although I was following their pictured pairing.

continue.text: I would continue to another chapter if it offered another clear cause-and-effect pathway like this one, though the final assembly was less interesting than seeing the kidney response.
